title: YOU + YOUR AGENT. SAME PROJECT.
subtitle: Same editing work. Shared control.
narration: In Synkinema, you and your AI agent can make the same edits to the same project. Automate the first cut, then change anything yourself.

title: START WITH A VISION
narration: Set your channel's voice, audience, and rules once. Every production starts with the right context.

title: MEDIA, READY TO USE
narration: Find footage fast in a searchable library, or keep assets private to one project.

title: CUT. LAYER. PREVIEW.
narration: Cut on a real timeline. Layer video, titles, voice, and music, then see the edit take shape.

title: FINE-TUNE EVERY FRAME
narration: Dial in framing, color, motion, and captions. The whole edit stays flexible.

title: STORY MEETS SOUND
narration: Keep the brief and script beside the cut. Record your voice, or generate it locally.

title: MIX WITH CONFIDENCE
narration: Duck music under speech and measure the loudness of your final mix.

title: SHIP THE REAL THING
narration: Render landscape or vertical video, inspect the frames, and export a ready-to-share M P four.

title: EXPERIMENT SAFELY
narration: Every revision is recoverable. Try ideas without losing your work.

title: HUMAN + AGENT
narration: Connect through M C P. Let an agent assemble the first cut, then take control in the same Studio.

title: OPEN SOURCE. LOCAL FIRST.
subtitle: AI voice: Supertonic 3
narration: Open source. Local first. Your story, your workflow. Synkinema.
